title: feat(app-shell): Studio Interfaces pillar creates a dashboard and a report and opens them on the structured canvas (objectui#11823 step 2)
body:
Refs #11823 (item 2)

Clause-②: no

Step 2 of objectui#11823: Studio's Interfaces pillar creates a **dashboard** and a **report** in a writable package, links each from the open app's navigation, and opens it on the structured canvas the pillar already renders for that type (ADR-0084; objectstack `docs/design/builder-ui.md` §6). Step 3 (pages) is not in this PR, so the card stays open.

## What changed

- **New menu** in the Interfaces rail header, beside *Edit*: *New dashboard* and *New report*. Offered only when the package is writable, the package has an app (the rail is the app's navigation, so there is nothing to link from otherwise), and nav editing is closed.
- **One handler** (`doCreateSurface`, inside `InterfacesPillar`), on submit of the shared `CreateItemDialog`:
  1. refuses an identifier that another item of the same type already holds, published in any package or as a draft in any package, and writes nothing (measured below: the draft door would have written over it);
  2. saves the item's draft through the pillar's `MetadataClient` (`client.save(type, name, body, { mode: 'draft', packageId })`);
  3. appends the linking entry to the app document and sends it through the nav editor's own save (`doNavSave`, which now takes the document to send as an optional second argument; the autosave still sends the buffer);
  4. closes the dialog and opens the new leaf in Design mode.
- **Bodies** (new module-private `studio-design/interfaceCreate.tsx`, typed as the spec's input types):
  - dashboard: `{ name, label, widgets: [] }`;
  - report: `{ name, label, type: 'summary', drilldown: true, dataset, values: [measure] }`. A non-joined report must name a dataset and at least one of its measures, or `ReportSchema` refuses it, so the report dialog asks for both (`ReportCreateFields`, rendered in the dialog's existing `extra` slot, offered from the same `useDatasetCatalog` the report's Properties panel binds from). Nothing is pre-chosen; a dataset change clears the measure. `type` and `drilldown` are seeded as the metadata editor's report create seeds them.
- **Nav entry**: `{ id: 'nav_NAME', type: 'dashboard', dashboardName }` with no label, so it inherits the dashboard's label at render (the objectui#11201 reading); `{ id, type: 'report', reportName, label }` for a report, because the spec's inheritance stops at object, view and dashboard targets and a label-less report entry shows its `reportName`. The id is unique at every depth of the tree (`nav_NAME_2`, ...).
- New `engine.studio.interfaces.create.*` rows (en and zh) in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, two test files, and a `patch` changeset on `@object-ui/app-shell`.

`CreateItemDialog.tsx` is unchanged (no new prop: the report's fields go in its `extra` slot). `index.ts` is unchanged, and the built entry does not reach the new module (reading below). `DashboardPreview` / `ReportPreview` are imported only.

## Zone 2 hypotheses, as measured

1. **The canvas exists; the create did not.** Confirmed on `bfca7ec`: the pillar's create dialogs were app (header), object, flow, permission set.
2. **The rail is the app's navigation.** Confirmed. The entry is written through the nav editor's save; with no app the menu is absent (pinned).
3. **Skeletons, measured against the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 and a published 17.7.0 server's draft door:**
   - a dashboard may have zero widgets: `widgets: []` parses and the door answers 200; with no `widgets` key both refuse (`widgets` invalid_type, door 422);
   - a report needs a dataset and a measure: the door answers 422 "a report needs `dataset` + `values` (measure names)" without them, 200 with them.
4. **Name and id.** The dialog's label-to-identifier derivation is reused unchanged. A taken identifier is refused in the dialog with no write. The check reads every package, not only this one, because the door (17.7.0) answered 200 both to a second draft under a name already drafted (it replaced the first draft) and to a draft named like a CODE package's dashboard ("Saved customization overlay": the empty skeleton would overlay that dashboard).
5. **Read-only scope** shows no create entry (pinned, and read in the browser on a code package). The package-less scope never mounts the Interfaces pillar.
6. **Refusals.** A refused item save stays in the dialog (as the other create dialogs show it) and links nothing; a refused nav save shows the canvas refusal strip (objectui#11785) and keeps the entry on screen and the buffer dirty (pinned).

## Tests and gates

Gate union run on local HEAD `89ce32a` (this branch with `origin/main` `5dff027` merged in, no rebase):

| Command | Exit | Verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| os-verify-lock: app-shell dependency-closure build, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` | 0 | `VERDICT command-exit 0` (29 of 47 projects) |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` the 60 `StudioDesignSurface.*` files | 0 | `Test Files 60 passed (60)` / `Tests 357 passed (357)` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` the other 62 `studio-design` test files | 0 | `Test Files 62 passed (62)` / `Tests 417 passed (417)` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` 40 tests that scan the tree, read a touched source or read the designer i18n tables (incl. `createConformance`, `viewCacheInvalidation.guard`, `block-config-i18n`, `studio-locale.i18n`) | 0 | `Test Files 40 passed (40)` / `Tests 397 passed (397)` |
| `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:spec-symbols` | 0 each | e.g. `Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders.`; `17 metadata write door(s) derived`; `0 new citation(s)` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` / `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 / 0 | `5 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` |

- The two new files: `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesCreate-11823.test.tsx` (10 tests, through the mounted pillar with a client double and the real `DashboardPreview` / `ReportPreview`; every saved body is parsed with `DashboardSchema`, `ReportSchema` and, for the app document, `AppSchema`) and `interfaceCreate.test.tsx` (9 tests). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both and the module.
- **Lint, narrowed and measured:** `eslint --format json` over the 5 touched files, under the root `eslint.config.js` the package's `eslint .` resolves: 5 files, 0 errors, 18 warnings. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` carries 13 warnings, the same 13 as on `main` `5dff027` (0 new); the new module carries 5 `react-refresh/only-export-components` (it exports the builders beside the one component). The config sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check:readme-exports` (prerequisite not met: it needs every package's `dist`; no export changed). The package's full 1121-file suite is CI's.
- **Published surface:** after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` (on `69a79ec`), walking the relative imports from `dist/index.d.ts` reaches 174 declaration files: `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` (control) and not `interfaceCreate.d.ts` or `CreateItemDialog.d.ts`; `StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` does not name the new module.

**Reverse check (on `69a79ec`, the implementation committed first), through `ablation-replace`:** the link dropped (`const linked = { ...base, navigation };` in place of the line that appends the entry). Predicted red, observed `Tests 3 failed | 7 passed (10)`: the dashboard pin's saved navigation lacks the entry, the report pin's last entry is `nav_docs`, and the nav-refusal pin finds no `dashboard · sales_overview` row in the rail. The dialog, item-save and canvas pins stayed green. Restored: blob `01af6a1` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Real-browser reading

Published `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 (`objectstack dev --fresh`) in a scratch directory, a code package (`com.probe.code`: an object, a dataset `probe_orders_ds` with measure `revenue`, a dashboard, an app) and a writable package `com.probe.ui` with an app; this branch's console (`69a79ec`) under Vite; Playwright/Chromium.

- *New dashboard* "Pipeline overview": `PUT .../meta/dashboard/pipeline_overview?mode=draft&package=com.probe.ui` (200, body `{"name":"pipeline_overview","label":"Pipeline overview","widgets":[]}`), then `PUT .../meta/app/probe_ui_app?mode=draft&package=com.probe.ui` (200) with the entry `{"id":"nav_pipeline_overview","type":"dashboard","dashboardName":"pipeline_overview"}` appended. The dialog closed, the rail showed the leaf, and the canvas opened in Design mode with "Add widget" and the dashboard's Properties panel.
- *New report* "Regional revenue": the measure select offered "Revenue (revenue)" once the dataset was chosen; `PUT .../meta/report/regional_revenue` (200, body as above with `dataset` and `values: ["revenue"]`), then the app `PUT` (200) with `{"id":"nav_regional_revenue","type":"report","reportName":"regional_revenue","label":"Regional revenue"}`. The canvas drew the report (`Revenue 35` over three seeded records) beside its Properties panel (Summary, Orders, revenue).
- "Sales overview" (a draft in another package) and the identifier `probe_code_dash` (the code package's dashboard) were each refused in the dialog with zero writes.
- The code package's Interfaces pillar showed neither *New* nor *Edit*.
- After Publish (`POST .../packages/com.probe.ui/publish-drafts`): the rail read "Pipeline overview" and "Regional revenue", and the running app's sidebar listed Order, Pipeline overview, Regional revenue.

## Acceptance notes

- Until the package is published, a new dashboard's rail row, breadcrumb and caption read its identifier (`pipeline_overview`): the label-less entry inherits from the console's published metadata, the same reading the objectui#11201 seeded entries give a draft object. After publish they read the label (above).
- The skeletons live in the new module rather than `skeletons.ts` (the claim's surface); `createConformance.test.ts`'s inline-creator list therefore does not include them, and the pins parse them with the spec schemas directly.
- Noted, not part of this change: on the dashboard canvas, "Add widget" births a widget (`{ id, type: 'metric', title }`) that the draft door refuses until a dataset is bound (17.7.0: 422, `widgets.0.dataset` and `widgets.0.values`), so the canvas shows "Changes not saved" right after the click. `DashboardPreview` is import-only here; reported to the seat with the reproduction.
